            <summary>
              <strong>allSuppliers</strong> <em>(SupplierConnection)</em>
            </summary>
            Supplier resources in this organization.
            Returns a connection containing all Supplier partners connected to this organization.
            Suppliers are the data providers/integrators that supply content through their APIs and configurations.
            Each supplier node includes provider information, service APIs, group content, and access data.
            The connection provides totalCount for the total number of suppliers.

            <summary>
              <strong>allClients</strong> <em>(ClientConnection)</em>
            </summary>
            Client resources in this organization.
            Returns a connection containing all Clients (API consumers/buyers) associated with this organization.
            Clients are entities that make requests and consume the services provided by suppliers through accesses.
            Each client node includes active status, group affiliation, password/legacy password info, and audit history.
            The connection provides totalCount and adviseMessage for operational feedback.

            <details>
              <summary>

              </summary>

              Returns a connection containing all Clients (API consumers/buyers) associated with this organization.
              Clients are entities that make requests and consume the services provided by suppliers through accesses.
              Each client node includes active status, group affiliation, password/legacy password info, and audit history.
              The connection provides totalCount and adviseMessage for operational feedback.
